import json, subprocess

def api(method, *fields):
    data = [('token', '<TOKEN>')]
    for f in fields:
        data.append(f)
    import urllib.parse
    body = urllib.parse.urlencode(data).encode()
    r = subprocess.run(['curl', '-s', '-X', 'POST', f'https://slack.com/api/{method}',
                        '--data', body.decode()], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return json.loads(r.stdout)

# 1) Find Deebo
u = api('users.list')

for usr in u.get('members', []):
    name = (usr.get('real_name') or '') + ' ' + (usr.get('profile', {}).get('display_name') or '')
    if 'farhan' in name.lower() or 'deebo' in name.lower():
        candidates.append((usr['id'], usr.get('real_name'), usr.get('profile', {}).get('display_name'), usr.get('deleted')))
print('USERS:', candidates)

# 2) Channel history

msgs = h.get('messages', [])
print('count=', len(msgs), 'ok=', h.get('ok'), h.get('error'))
for m in msgs:
    if m.get('subtype'):

    reactions = m.get('reactions', [])
    eyes = [r['name'] for r in reactions if r['name'] == 'eyes']

    marker = ' [EYES]' if eyes else ''
    print(m['ts'], m['user'], marker, text[:160])
